title: EducatesInlineConfig
description: BYO scenario. User asserts that cert-manager (or pre-issued wildcard cert), an ingress controller, and a policy engine already exist on the cluster.

apiVersion.description: API version of the configuration kind. Always cli.educates.dev/v1alpha1.

domain.description: Wildcard ingress domain Educates serves workshops under. You arrange DNS for it yourself.

ingressClassName.description: Name of the existing IngressClass routing to your ingress controller, for example contour or openshift-default.

wildcardCertificateSecret.description: Name of an existing kubernetes.io/tls Secret in the operator namespace holding tls.crt and tls.key valid for *.<domain>. Required unless externalTLSTermination is set.

caCertificateSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret with a ca.crt key for the CA chain that issued the wildcard certificate. Workshops mount it when they need to trust calls to endpoints signed by that CA. Optional.

clusterIssuerName.description: Name of the cert-manager ClusterIssuer that signed the wildcard certificate, if any. Informational; surfaced in status. Optional.

imageRegistry.description: Rewrite workshop image references to live behind an in-cluster or mirror registry, and supply pull credentials for it.

prefix.description: Registry prefix that workshop image references are rewritten to live under.

pullSecrets.description: Names of image pull Secrets for the rewritten registry.

policyEnforcement.description: The security policy engines the cluster already enforces. Educates identifies them rather than installing them. Defaults to Kyverno for both.

clusterEngine.description: Cluster-wide policy engine already in place. None disables cluster-level enforcement.

workshopEngine.description: Per-workshop policy engine already in place. None disables workshop-level enforcement.

externalTLSTermination.description: Asserts TLS for the ingress domain is terminated outside the cluster (external load balancer or proxy forwarding plain HTTP inward). No in-cluster wildcard certificate is referenced and generated portal and workshop URLs use https. Maps to EducatesClusterConfig inline ingress.protocol https with no wildcardCertificateSecretRef; wildcardCertificateSecret is not required when set.

clusterAdmin.description: Grant workshop sessions cluster-admin access. Disabled by default.

lookupService.description: Deploy the lookup service used for service discovery across training portals. Enabled by default.

imagePrePuller.description: Pre-pull workshop images onto every node ahead of time so session startup is not blocked on image pulls. Enabled by default.

websiteStyling.description: Customisation of the workshop dashboard and training portal appearance.

defaultTheme.description: Name of the theme applied to workshop sessions and portals by default.

themeDataRefs.description: Secrets holding theme data (CSS, HTML, JavaScript) to load into the cluster.

namespace.description: Namespace of the Secret holding the theme data.

name.description: Name of the Secret holding the theme data.

secretPropagation.description: Secrets to copy into workshop session namespaces.

imagePullSecretNames.description: Names of image pull Secrets to make available to workshop sessions.

imageVersions.description: Per-component image overrides. Each entry points a named platform component at a specific image.

name.description: Component name to override, for example session-manager or training-portal.

image.description: Full image reference (repository and tag) to use for the component.

operator.description: Settings for the Educates installer operator deployment.

image.description: Image used for the installer operator. Defaults to the image matching the CLI version.

pullPolicy.description: Image pull policy. When empty the chart derives it: Always for floating tags, IfNotPresent otherwise.

imagePullSecrets.description: Names of image pull Secrets the operator deployment should use.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity for the operator and platform components.
